title: Spectral Graph Uncertainty Principles via the Graph Fractional Fourier Transform
summary: This paper develops a graph fractional uncertainty principle in the graph fractional Fourier transform (GFRFT) domain. We introduce localization operators in the vertex domain and the graph fractional spectral domain, and build an operator framework to characterize the joint localization of graph signals. A sandwiched joint localization operator is first constructed, whose largest eigenvalue quantifies the attainable simultaneous concentration in the two domains.
